chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Saʿd ibn Abī Khalaf, from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام, that he said to one of his children:

My son, beware lest Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, see you in a sin from which He has forbidden you. And beware lest Allah, the Exalted, find you absent from an act of obedience that He has commanded you to do. Be diligent, and do not absolve yourself of falling short in the worship of Allah, for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, is not worshipped as He truly deserves to be worshipped. Beware of jesting, for it takes away the light of your faith and makes light of your dignity. And beware of laziness and weariness, for they prevent you from your share of this world and the Hereafter.

key_terms.التَّقْصِيرِ فِي عِبَادَةِ اللَّهِ: Falling short in worshipping Allah as He deserves.
key_terms.الْجِدِّ: Seriousness, diligence, and earnest effort in conduct and worship.
key_terms.الْكَسَلَ وَ الضَّجَرَ: Laziness and weary impatience that hinder worldly and spiritual benefit.
key_terms.الْمِزَاحَ: Joking or jesting, especially when excessive and spiritually harmful.
key_terms.طَاعَةٍ: An act of obedience that Allah has commanded.
key_terms.مَعْصِيَةٍ: An act of disobedience or sin against Allah’s command.
key_terms.مُرُوءَتِكَ: One’s dignity, honor, and moral bearing.
key_terms.نُورِ إِيمَانِكَ: The illuminating quality and spiritual light of one’s faith.

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام teach about sin, worship, joking, and laziness?
ai.summary: This hadith is a moral exhortation from Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام to his son, urging constant awareness of Allah in both avoiding sin and fulfilling obedience. It emphasizes diligence in worship, humility regarding one’s shortcomings, and warns against frivolous joking, laziness, and weariness because these harm faith, dignity, and one’s success in both this world and the Hereafter.
